meta.name: research
meta.description: Evidence-first research with mandatory citations and source evaluation. Use when gathering information for decisions, comparing approaches, investigating unknowns, or any task requiring verified evidence from multiple sources. Invoke at the START of research, not when writing up results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查证多来源信息并给出带引用的可靠答案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做决定前需要核实多方信息并追溯来源。
copy.tagline_en: Gather verified evidence from multiple sources with citations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need verified facts from multiple sources before making decisions.

howto.what: Claude 会把你的问题拆成若干子问题，先规划搜索角度，再并行检索多个独立来源。它会在每个事实声明后标注出处（如 [docs: 官方文档]），并明确区分事实、综合分析和推测。最后输出带引用、差距说明和可信度评估的研究报告。
howto.when: 当你需要收集信息做决定、比较方案、调查未知，或需要来自多个来源的验证证据时触发。应在研究一开始就调用，而不是在写结果时。

say.text: 比较 Redis 和 PostgreSQL 的缓存性能，每个结论都要标来源。
say.note: Claude 会按证据层级分类并标注引用。

say.text: 调查量子计算行业现状，找出至少三个独立来源交叉验证。
say.note: 它会找出矛盾并说明来源差异。

say.text: 帮我查一下这个 API 的限流机制，声明来源类型和可信度。
say.note: 它会评估来源可信度并标出不确定项。

howto.what_en: Claude frames the question, plans searches, retrieves from multiple independent sources, cites inline, labels fact vs inference, and reports gaps and confidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need evidence for decisions, comparing options, investigating unknowns, or any task requiring verified facts from multiple sources. Invoke at the start of research, not when writing results.

say_en.text: Compare Redis vs PostgreSQL cache performance; cite every claim.
say_en.note: Claude will tier the evidence and label citations.

say_en.text: Investigate the state of quantum computing with at least three independent sources.
say_en.note: It will triangulate and note gaps.

say_en.text: Find out this API's rate limits; label source types and credibility.
say_en.note: It will evaluate sources and flag uncertainty.
